text:
violet: opened PR that corrects a few issues in the API reference for /v1/stream (streaming generate). Found while wiring up incremental rendering in the web SDK.

violet: problems I hit:
- `stop` is documented as `string` only but runtime accepts array[string] (multiple stop sequences).
- streaming event payloads in the docs show `text` fields but runtime uses `delta` objects for partial tokens: `{event: 'chunk', data: {delta: 'o'}}` and finalization event includes `finish_reason`.
- `max_tokens` default wasn't documented — runtime defaults to 256 if omitted, which matters for cost estimates.

jared: can you paste the docs snippets that are wrong? i'll update the OpenAPI and the example JS streaming client.

violet: current (wrong) param snippet:
```yaml
parameters:
  stop:
    type: string
```
should be:
```yaml
parameters:
  stop:
    oneOf:
      - type: string
      - type: array
        items:
          type: string
    description: "One or more stop sequences to terminate generation"
```

violet: streaming event example (runtime) I observed and added to the PR examples:
```json
{ "event": "chunk", "data": { "delta": "Hel" } }
{ "event": "chunk", "data": { "delta": "lo" } }
{ "event": "done",  "data": { "finish_reason": "stop" } }
```
Docs currently show `data.text` which breaks the incremental renderer.

paul: agree. also add `max_tokens` default 256 to the parameter doc and call out that projects that assume unlimited tokens will see costs.

jared: i'll change openapi: stop -> oneOf str|array, streaming schema delta: string, add finish_reason to final event, and add default for max_tokens: 256. Note: generators that produce TS defs require an explicit default field.

doc-bot: openapi-check flagged a broken reference in docs/guides/streaming.md: line 34

violet: fixed the anchor and force-pushed. added a tiny JS example for handling delta chunks and finish reason:
```js
const reader = await fetch(streamUrl)
for await (const line of sseLines(reader)) {
  const ev = JSON.parse(line)
  if (ev.event === 'chunk') render(ev.data.delta)
  if (ev.event === 'done') console.log('finished:', ev.data.finish_reason)
}
```

paul: LGTM from docs side. please add migration note under docs/migration/v1.3.md about `stop` being array/string and streaming payload change (delta vs text) for SDKs that parse raw events.

jared: added migration note and updated the Python/Go SDK parsers in a follow-up PR.

doc-bot: CI: All checks passed \u2705 (lint, unit, openapi-check)

violet: merged. will follow up to propagate example into react-web-sdk recipe. Thanks! :sparkles:
